description: Pressing Super during a workspace gesture animation leaves the workspace switcher stuck between two states.
expected_report: While a touchpad gesture animation of the workspace switcher is in progress, the user presses Super; the overview gets stuck in an intermediate state, with odd animations. Expected: a consistent final state.
difficulty: Touchpad gesture and a key press are invisible inputs, the bug is an animation state.
